result:
Nothing at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 over 436 items, and all four of its counts were 0.

The checker doesn't list entries with several Status lines, so I found them with a scratch script. 38 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line. For each, I took the last Status line, which is the current one. All 38 end in closed, mitigated or moved Out, and every earlier Status line differs. My script ran from `$TMPDIR` and changed nothing in the repo. I shortened the reasons below, and a few are cut off in my output and not read in full.

**setup.md**
- RISK-401 (L5), mitigated 2026-11-18: routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-410 (L4), closed: outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- RISK-411 (L3), mitigated 2026-11-19: the session-start fill removes the retired text.

**cost.md**
- RISK-374 (L5), mitigated 2026-11-18: the spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 and RISK-393 (L3), mitigated 2026-11-19: the fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote.
  - An earlier status accepted the risk. That acceptance was the user's to give, and it was withdrawn.

**reply.md**
- RISK-226 (L4), RISK-262, RISK-264, RISK-352, RISK-353 and RISK-362 (L5), and RISK-278 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19: the defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
- RISK-227 (L3), mitigated 2026-11-19: the output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-497 (L4, 7 Status lines), mitigated 2026-11-19: line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture and an untouched fixture, and holds the control at 6/6.

**delegation.md**
- RISK-166 (L4), closed 2026-11-19: not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327.
- RISK-169 (L4), closed: the cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard, and those checks were removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016).
- RISK-170, RISK-199 and RISK-223, mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files (Verified line).
- RISK-171 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19: the consent paragraph and the agent files beat vanilla on r171b and r171d.
- RISK-185 (L3), mitigated 2026-11-19: the output-style paragraph on reading a background command's output beats vanilla on r185a and r185b.
- RISK-186 (L5), mitigated 2026-11-19: it records the fix to the Bash wrapper's `{ ... } </dev/null` group (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45).
- RISK-222 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-18: `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.

**guards.md**
- RISK-053 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19, with a gap closed: odd path spellings and an unclosed `[` had passed the wall guard.
- RISK-055 (L4), closed 2026-11-19: pkill and killall ask first.
- RISK-059 (L3), closed 2026-11-18: the gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021).
- RISK-063 (L3), closed 2026-11-19: destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (L4), closed 2026-11-19: the deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- RISK-067 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19 for git: the ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and branch -D, including the `git -C dir` form.
- RISK-071 (L5), closed 2026-11-18: the `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log are dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- RISK-103 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19: the probe showed the gap was the prefix match, which is fixed.

**verification.md**
- RISK-424 (L3), mitigated 2026-11-18: the threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- RISK-451 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19: the output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d.
- RISK-462 (L4), moved Out as OUT-2777 (Verified line). The checker passes it, so the OUT entry gives a not-shipped reason.
- RISK-463 (L3), closed 2026-11-19: the fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs.

**edit.md**
- RISK-416 (L5), mitigated 2026-11-19: one line in the output style and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for one `perl -pi`/`-0pi` call when a change repeats across files.

**handover.md**
- RISK-132 (L4), mitigated 2026-11-19 for options the user refused: the handover keeps every user correction, refusal and consent word for word.
